mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an aggressive monetary tightening cycle in response to persistent inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% MoM and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% MoM in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS have risen by the specified thresholds in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening economic activity and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when the economy is in a post-recession recovery and HOUST has increased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in both retail sales (RSAFS) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending and labor market strength, which together drive stronger-than-expected corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.3% MoM and PAYEMS rises > 0.2% MoM in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and PAYEMS have risen by the specified thresholds in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter signals sustained economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 has shown positive YoY growth.
